ex.en: I want to enroll at graduate school.
ex.zh: 我想就讀研究所。

ex.en: She enrolled in an evening English class.
ex.zh: 她報名了夜間英文班。

ex.en: The app encrypts all your messages.
ex.zh: 這個 App 會把你所有的訊息加密。

ex.en: Encrypted files cannot be read without a password.
ex.zh: 加密的檔案沒有密碼就無法讀取。

ex.en: Videos usually get more engagement than photos.
ex.zh: 影片通常比照片獲得更多互動。

ex.en: We're trying to increase customer engagement.
ex.zh: 我們正努力提高顧客參與度。

ex.en: I congratulate you on your engagement.
ex.zh: 恭喜你訂婚了。

ex.en: He announced his engagement to her.
ex.zh: 他宣布和她訂婚。

ex.en: "Didn't you get married!?" "Oh, we split up. We broke our engagement."
ex.zh: 「你們不是結婚了嗎？」「喔，我們分手了，婚約也取消了。」

ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
ex.zh: 工程師告訴我們如何使用機器。

ex.en: I cannot calculate this. I am not an engineer.
ex.zh: 我算不出來，我不是工程師。

ex.en: The committee consists of scientists and engineers.
ex.zh: 委員會由科學家和工程師組成。

ex.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
ex.zh: 我們應該對人類使用基因工程嗎？

ex.en: Genetic engineering can make crops resistant to disease.
ex.zh: 基因工程可以讓作物抵抗疾病。

ex.en: It is an endangered species.
ex.zh: 這是一種瀕臨絕種的物種。

ex.en: There are many endangered species.
ex.zh: 有許多瀕危物種。

ex.en: Murdering elephants, tigers and other endangered species is not just cruel; it's also illegal.
ex.zh: 殺害大象、老虎等瀕危物種不只殘忍，也是違法的。

ex.en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
ex.zh: 問題是太陽能太貴了。

ex.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 核子反應爐會產生大量的熱能。

ex.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.
ex.zh: 我在這項計劃上投入了所有精力。

ex.en: All his energies were devoted to the experiment.
ex.zh: 他把全部精力都投入了實驗。

ex.en: If you concentrate all your energies on the study of English, you will master the language.
ex.zh: 如果你把全部精力都放在學英文上，你就能精通這門語言。

ex.en: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
ex.zh: 我們應該盡力不污染環境。

ex.en: They have no impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 它們對環境沒有任何影響。

ex.en: Eating meat is bad for the environment.
ex.zh: 吃肉對環境不利。

ex.en: They live in a good environment.
ex.zh: 他們生活的環境很好。

ex.en: I work best in a quiet environment.
ex.zh: 我在安靜的環境中工作效率最好。

ex.en: My son is engaged to his secretary.
ex.zh: 我的兒子和他的秘書訂婚了。

ex.en: She is engaged to a rich man.
ex.zh: 她和一個有錢人訂了婚。

ex.en: He got engaged to my cousin.
ex.zh: 他和我的堂姊妹訂婚了。

ex.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
ex.zh: 我父親從事外貿多年。

ex.en: They are engaged in cancer research.
ex.zh: 他們從事癌症研究工作。

ex.en: All entrees come with a salad.
ex.zh: 所有主菜都附沙拉。

ex.en: I'll have the fish as my entree.
ex.zh: 我主菜要點魚。

ex.en: Enthusiasts of Japanese culture may enjoy the article "Ergativity and Bare Nouns in Early Old Japanese."
ex.zh: 日本文化愛好者可能會喜歡〈早期古日語的作格性與光桿名詞〉這篇文章。

ex.en: He's a car enthusiast who spends every weekend in his garage.
ex.zh: 他是汽車迷，每個週末都待在車庫裡。

ex.en: The athlete earns millions from endorsements.
ex.zh: 那位運動員靠代言賺了數百萬。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can boost sales.
ex.zh: 名人代言可以提升銷量。

ex.en: A translation is not an endorsement.
ex.zh: 翻譯不代表認同。

ex.en: The plan received the endorsement of the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得董事會的支持。

ex.en: They entertained us at dinner last night.
ex.zh: 他們昨晚請我們吃晚餐。

ex.en: We often entertain clients at this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們常在這家餐廳招待客戶。

ex.en: He entertained us with jokes all evening.
ex.zh: 他整晚講笑話逗我們開心。

ex.en: The clown entertained the children.
ex.zh: 小丑逗得孩子們很開心。

ex.en: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
ex.zh: 請在建築的入口處等我。

ex.en: Some people were hanging around at the entrance.
ex.zh: 有些人在入口處停留。

ex.en: Because the entrance was locked, we couldn't enter the house.
ex.zh: 因為門口鎖住了，我們進不了屋子。

ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
ex.zh: 我聽說你通過了入學考試。恭喜你了！

ex.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.
ex.zh: 他忙著準備入學考試。

ex.en: Entry is strictly for staff only.
ex.zh: 僅限工作人員進入。

ex.en: Disregarding the "No Entry" sign, she pushed open the door and walked inside.
ex.zh: 她不理會「禁止進入」的牌子，推開門走了進去。

ex.en: This dictionary has about 40,000 entries.
ex.zh: 這本字典大約有四萬個詞條。

ex.en: I made an entry in my diary every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上都會寫一篇日記。

ex.en: She sent me the enclosed check.
ex.zh: 她把隨信附上的支票寄給了我。

ex.en: Please find the enclosed contract.
ex.zh: 隨函附上合約，請查收。
